component.name: tinystream
component.summary: Watch and listen together on your own media server

description.p: The desktop app for tinystream, a small self-hosted media server for your shows, movies, music and books. Connect it to your server to browse your libraries and play them with hardware decoding and the subtitles drawn right.

ul.li: Shows and movies, with chapters, track choices and picture in picture
Music and books from the same libraries
Watch Together and Listen Together, joined from a tinystream:// link
Clips of any moment, made and shared from the player
Requests, a calendar and downloads, and the server's settings for admins
Media controls, notifications and a tray icon on your desktop
